build: bun --version && (bun install --no-save || bun install) && if bun run -s build >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run build; else echo "[forgeon] missing script: build (expected nitro build)"; exit 1; fi
start: if bun run -s preview >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run preview; else if [ -f .output/server/index.mjs ]; then node .output/server/index.mjs; else echo "[forgeon] missing script: preview and missing entry: .output/server/index.mjs"; exit 1; fi; fi

build_meta.notes: Nitro output is .output; start via preview script or node .output/server/index.mjs
